budget.fixedShapeChargeEvidence: 부모 세션이 PixelLab search_help 문서에서 edit_image 32–256 크기 tier 10 generations, 512 tier 25 generations를 확인했다. 이 작업은 모든 call을 2 frames, 64×64로 고정한다. 첫 완료의 실제 청구도 10 generations였다.

evidence.baseImageInspection: view_image로 아타호·연묵·비월의 south-east/north-west 원본 PNG 6장을 직접 확인했다. PNG 헤더로 크기를 확인하고 SHA-256과 byte 크기를 기록했다.
evidence.techniqueReferenceEvidence: 부모 세션이 Kotaku 포즈 정적 예시를 확인했다. 실제 영상 재생은 이번 자산 단계에서 확인하지 않았다.

evidence.alphaBoundsConvention: PIL getbbox의 right/bottom은 마지막 픽셀 다음의 배타적 경계이다. 이미지 전체를 회전하거나 반전하지 않았다.

entries.plannedPrompt: Redraw BOTH supplied original Biwol rabbit-ninja pixel sprites into a clearly airborne, dramatic anime declaration key pose. The first is the original SOUTH-EAST front three-quarter view and MUST stay south-east; the second is the original NORTH-WEST rear three-quarter view and MUST stay north-west with the back of the body visible. Preserve each input's character identity, asymmetric rabbit ears, dark-plum ninja clothing, brick-coloured scarf, colours and short dagger. Do not mirror either direction, do not rotate the whole original sprite, and do not copy a standing or running pose. In BOTH views, draw a strong whole-body C-shaped curve: the hips push forward while the spine visibly arches backward, the upper chest and head pull markedly back behind the hips, one leg stretches long diagonally downward and forward, and the other leg is sharply bent with the knee raised so the legs have clearly different shapes. BOTH feet must be visibly airborne with pointed foot tips and no standing support. This torso back-arch and large curved leg silhouette MUST be just as clear in the NORTH-WEST BACK view as in the front view. Put the short dagger in the forward extended hand, and let the brick-coloured scarf trail behind the arched torso. Keep the entire body, ears, scarf, dagger and BOTH complete foot tips within a 64x64 transparent canvas, leaving at least TWO fully transparent pixels of margin on ALL four sides. Maintain the same character scale in the two outputs while folding the airborne silhouette to fit; crisp original pixel-art style, no text, no background, no ground, no effects, no extra characters. One held endpoint pose per input, two independent directional views of the SAME airborne pose, not an animation or sprite sheet.
